# Exp <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Exp:Float32 float:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `float` | In | Float32 | required | The exponent. |

**Returns:** e to the power of `float`.

## Description

Returns e (2.71828...) raised to the given power. It is the opposite of [Log](Log).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Exp(1)
```

```text
2.71828
```
